info.title: Meziantou.Framework.AtlassianDataFormat.Tool
info.description: CLI to convert Atlassian Document Format (ADF) documents to Markdown using Meziantou.Framework.AtlassianDataFormat

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Convert Atlassian Document Format (ADF) documents to Markdown using Meziantou.Framework.AtlassianDataFormat

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --input
options.description: Path to the ADF JSON file to convert. If omitted, reads from stdin

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to the Markdown file to write. If omitted, writes to stdout

options.name: --heading-style
options.description: Style used for headings [default: Atx]

options.name: --emphasis-marker
options.description: Marker used for emphasis [default: Asterisk]

options.name: --code-block-style
options.description: Style used for code blocks [default: Fenced]

options.name: --code-block-fence-character
options.description: Fence character used for fenced code blocks [default: `]

options.name: --unordered-list-marker
options.description: Marker used for unordered lists [default: -]

options.name: --thematic-break
options.description: Text used for horizontal rules [default: ---]

options.name: --line-break-style
options.description: Style used for line breaks [default: TrailingSpaces]

options.name: --panel-style
options.description: Style used for panels [default: Blockquote]

options.name: --expand-style
options.description: Style used for collapsible sections [default: Blockquote]

options.name: --table-style
options.description: Style used for tables [default: PipeTable]

options.name: --media-rendering
options.description: Rendering used for media items [default: Image]

options.name: --emoji-rendering
options.description: Rendering used for emoji [default: Text]

options.name: --task-list-style
options.description: Style used for task lists [default: Checkbox]

options.name: --decision-list-style
options.description: Style used for decision lists [default: BulletList]

options.name: --unknown-node-handling
options.description: Handling of nodes whose type is not part of the supported schema [default: Skip]

options.name: --mention-format
options.description: Format used for mentions, where {text} is the display name and {id} the account identifier [default: @{text}]

options.name: --status-format
options.description: Format used for status lozenges, where {text} is the text and {color} the color [default: `{text}`]

options.name: --date-format
options.description: Format used for dates, applied with the invariant culture [default: yyyy-MM-dd]
